questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in the context of a strongly negative statement?
options: It was not until the meeting ended that we realised the importance of the project.
Only when the storm passed did the rescue team begin their search.
Not until the last minute did the team decide to cancel the trip.
She never would have agreed to help if she had known the risks.
questions.answer: Only when the storm passed did the rescue team begin their search.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft construction to highlight the subject of a clause?
options: The fact that he failed the exam surprised everyone; it was his first mistake.
What surprised everyone was that he failed the exam, despite his preparation.
Everyone was surprised that he failed the exam; he had prepared well.
It was surprising that he failed the exam; he had prepared well.
questions.answer: What surprised everyone was that he failed the exam, despite his preparation.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood in a hypothetical context involving a formal request?
options: She insists that he be given the promotion immediately.
He suggested that we go to the meeting tomorrow.
They proposed that the budget be reviewed before finalising the plans.
He advised that we not leave the documents in the car.
questions.answer: She insists that he be given the promotion immediately.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs ellipsis to maintain coherence in a complex sentence structure?
options: After finishing her thesis, she decided to travel, and then she began teaching.
Although she had planned to study abroad, she decided to stay home instead, and then she started her career.
She wanted to take up painting, but she didn’t have time, and then she began to explore other creative outlets.
He had already read the report, so he didn’t need to re-examine it, and then he moved on to the next section.
questions.answer: After finishing her thesis, she decided to travel, and then she began teaching.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates the use of formal register with a nuanced grammatical choice in discussing academic research?
options: The findings of the study are quite interesting; however, the methodology needs improvement.
The research indicates that the results are not entirely conclusive, and further analysis is required.
It was found that the data was inconsistent, so we had to discard it all.
The data seems to be unreliable, and therefore we cannot trust the conclusions drawn.
questions.answer: The research indicates that the results are not entirely conclusive, and further analysis is required.
